name: dev.ucp.common.business
title: Business Capability
description: Capability schema for location-independent business and brand identity metadata in business discovery profiles.

category.title: Business Category
category.description: A business category entry. The first entry in `categories` is the primary category.

value.description: The category code or label (e.g., `'5812'`, `'722511'`, `'Pizza restaurant'`).

taxonomy.description: The classification system for `value`. Well-known values: `mcc` (ISO 18245 Merchant Category Code), `naics`, `isic`, `merchant` (free-form business-supplied label). Open vocabulary; a Platform MUST ignore unrecognized taxonomy values.

config.title: Business Configuration
config.description: Location-independent identity metadata for the business or brand represented by the profile.

categories.description: Ordered business categories; the first entry is the primary category.

business_schema.title: Business Capability (Business)
business_schema.description: Business-level declaration carrying location-independent identity metadata for the business or brand.
